description: Compat drop-in for twitter_monitor_create using an x_user_stream-shaped request/response envelope: watch an X account for new posts, translated onto the same underlying monitor system. Free per call. Prefer twitter_monitor_create for new integrations; this exists for migrating an existing x_user_stream-shaped integration without a rewrite.

x_user_name.description: The X username to watch, without the @.

name: twitter_x_user_stream_add_user
